UIO_NEWCHAR_CTL_CHINESE_TT:
The Chinese can bring out the mysterious energy of the east and use it in many ways to fight their enemy. 
They also have strong classes so they do not have to play in large numbers. They can train in many ways according to how they learned up to 2 skill masteries.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MSG_CREATE: Do you want to create a new character?
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_ADVENTURER_EXPLANATION: The son of a famous military family. His family was destroyed by a faction of people who feared his parents' influence and he alone survived. He waits for the day of revenge.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_BOGY_EXPLANATION: The eldest son of Ghost family. His ugly face forced him to travel in order to seek revenge on the human beings who despised his family.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_FIGHTER_EXPLANATION: A fighter with scars on his face and back. His memory was lost one day, he starts traveling to find himself.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_MERCHANT_EXPLANATION: He was one of the richest men in Jangan city, but lost it all in a day when he refused to offer bribes from villanious retainers of the palace. He is now trying his luck on the Silkroad.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_MONK_EXPLANATION: Selected as a monk fighter that the secret unit Jaeunsa had organized. Jaeunsa sent him to the Silkroad in order to save his country.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_MONKEY_EXPLANATION: A youth from Hyowon minority tribe on Whagwa mountain. Due to his monkeylike face, he is not friendly with human beings, but leaves the mountain by the order of Jecheondaeseong and reaches Jangan city.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_NECROMANCER_EXPLANATION: A magician of esoteric Buddhism who uses zombie skill. At last, he came to create his dream, the perfect zombie ghost. But misunderstood as the chief instigator of the sudden monster influx around Jangan city, he was exiled.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_NOBLEBOY_EXPLANATION: As the son of a high official from the palace, he grew up arrogant with his father's power. But he went to Constantinople by the King's order...
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_PERFORMER_EXPLANATION: As an opera actor, His vagabond theatrical troupe went bankrupt and all the members left. He travels the Silkroad to earn enough money to rebuild the troupe.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_PRIEST_EXPLANATION: A high monk of Jaeunsa. One day, he experienced spiritual awakening and went to Cheonchuk to get the Sutra.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_SCHOLAR_EXPLANATION: As a young scholar from the palace, he was attracted to European culture introduced to him through the Silkroad and he decided to explore it all.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_TATTOO_EXPLANATION: Instead of being executed as the son of a traitor, he suffered punishment of being disgracefully tattooed all over the body. He leaves Jangan to escape the scrutiny and travels the Silkroad.
UIO_NEWCHAR_MAN_WARRIOR_EXPLANATION: A man who went to Balhae to master his martial art. At last, he came to Jangan after wandering the world with the great ambition of being the best.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_ADVENTURER_EXPLANATIO: Accompanying her mother to Silla, she indulged herself with the foreign culture. She snuck out and joined the trade caravans on the Silkroad.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_ASSASSIN_EXPLANATION: As a decendant of a Saracenic family who migrated  to the western country, she learned assassin skills to support her family.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_BOGY_EXPLANATION: The youngest daughter of a Ghost family, so called Kuisalsega, and Kungroe's younger sister. She steps out into the world to find her brother.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_FIGHTER_EXPLANATION: A girl who travels the world to revenge on  her enemy. She seems to be related with Kongsonryuun who lost his memory.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_FOX_EXPLANATION: A descendant of the minority Yorang tribe in the Namman region. To rescue her people who were sold as the slaves, she has left her home and arrived at Jangan.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_KANGSI_EXPLANATION: Perfect female Zombie who has been created  by Deoklabeopwang. But, her body has been taken control by the evil force.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_KISAENG_EXPLANATION: A gisaeng from the red-light district in Jangan. She indulged herself with the fantastic adventures of her clients and decided to make her own adventure on the Silkroad.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_MERCHANT_EXPLANATION: A young widow. She journeys on the Silkroad to find her missing husband.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_NECROMANCERB_EXPLANAT: A woman who learned dark magic to save her beloved one once he fell unconscious. She sets off to fine medicine to cure him.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_NECROMANCERW_EXPLANAT: As a sorceress who serves the god of the north tribes, she came out to the world to find a way for her tribal people to escape the coming misfortune.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_NOBLEGIRL_EXPLANATION: A clever girl from a high class family. She entices her friend Wolyeon to join her adventures on the Silkroad.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_SCHOLAR_EXPLANATION: Against her parents' will, she is obsessed with martial art books since her childhood. She is a friend of Choseal.
UIO_NEWCHAR_FEMALE_WARRIOR_EXPLANATION: She was a deserted baby who was found and raised by a fighter. She felt at home with him as if he was her real father. But one day he suddenly disappeared and she sets out to find him.
